exceptions: Moon frame only in Mode B

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit)

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit)
rules.conditions: AD lord from MD lord: houses 1/7,3/11,4/10,5/9 (incl. conjunction) clean; 2/12 or 6/8 friction -> MIXED

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit)
rules.conditions: transiting Jupiter AND Saturn each occupy or aspect the primary E-house sign or E-lord natal sign from Lagna (Moon secondary, weight 0.5); window = PD/AD intersected with the joint transit interval

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit)
rules.conditions: AD lord's weighted links to ADV (12th from each E) outweigh links to E (links.link_balance) -> ADVERSE
